item.title: Earthquake off Tamarinda rattles coastal cities
item.description: Earthquake off Tamarinda rattles coastal cities. The quake struck about 40 kilometres offshore at a shallow depth, the geological survey said. At least 12 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said.

item.title: Geneva talks: Estovia, Karelan envoys meet on border ceasefire
item.description: Geneva talks: Estovia, Karelan envoys meet on border ceasefire. Mediators said discussions focused on a monitored ceasefire along the border.

item.title: Polls open in Ostrava Republic presidential runoff
item.description: Polls open in Ostrava Republic presidential runoff. Opinion polls had shown the two candidates separated by only a few points.

item.title: Mirabel wildfires: evacuation orders widen as winds rise
item.description: Mirabel wildfires: evacuation orders widen as winds rise. Emergency services said more than 3,000 residents had been told to leave their homes.

item.title: Former Carvonia minister goes on trial for corruption
item.description: Former Carvonia minister goes on trial for corruption. Officials said more details were expected later today.
